```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read.csv("data/capacity_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ── Paleta completa: políticas originais + variantes sw ─────────────────────
POL_COLORS <- c(
  "round-robin"      = "#378ADD",
  "round-robin-sw"   = "#7db8e8",
  "pf-classic"       = "#D85A30",
  "pf-classic-sw"    = "#e8956a",
  "aoi-pure"         = "#1D9E75",
  "aoi-normalized"   = "#2DC4A0",
  "risk-aware"       = "#7F77DD",
  "max-weight-drift" = "#F4A261",
  "max-weight-sw"    = "#f9c784"
)

BG   <- "#1e1e2e"; PANEL <- "#13131f"
TEXT <- "#cdd6f4"; AXIS  <- "#a6adc8"; GRID <- "#2a2a4a"
C_TICKS    <- sort(unique(df$C))
QOS_TARGET <- 0.85

# Labels e highlights por experimento — adicionar aqui novos experimentos
EXP_LABELS <- c(
  "capacity_15min"        = "15 min · original",
  "capacity_15min_sw_nsw" = "15 min · sw vs nsw"
)
EXP_HIGHLIGHT <- list(
  "capacity_15min"        = c("max-weight-drift", "aoi-normalized"),
  "capacity_15min_sw_nsw" = c("max-weight-sw", "max-weight-drift")
)

get_exp_label     <- function(e) { l <- EXP_LABELS[[e]];     if (is.null(l)) e else l }
get_exp_highlight <- function(e) { h <- EXP_HIGHLIGHT[[e]];  if (is.null(h)) character(0) else h }

# ── make_ply: curvas C × métrica por política ────────────────────────────────
make_ply <- function(d, y_col, y_title) {
  agg <- if (nrow(d) > 0)
    group_by(d, C, policy) |>
      summarise(y = mean(.data[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  else
    data.frame(C = integer(), policy = character(), y = double())

  pols <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(agg$policy))
  fig  <- plot_ly()

  for (pol in pols) {
    sub <- filter(agg, policy == pol)
    fig <- add_trace(fig,
      data = sub, x = ~C, y = ~y,
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", name = pol,
      line   = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], width = 2),
      marker = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], size  = 5),
      hovertemplate = paste0("<b>", pol, "</b><br>C=%{x}<br>",
                             y_title, "=%{y:.3g}<extra></extra>")
    )
  }

  if (length(pols) == 0)
    fig <- add_annotations(fig, text = "Sem dados", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
                           xref = "paper", yref = "paper", showarrow = FALSE,
                           font = list(color = AXIS, size = 14))

  layout(fig,
    title  = list(text = y_title, font = list(color = TEXT, size = 11)),
    xaxis  = list(title = "C", color = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID,
                  tickvals = C_TICKS, zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis  = list(title = "", color = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE),
    plot_bgcolor  = PANEL, paper_bgcolor = BG,
    font   = list(color = TEXT, size = 10),
    legend = list(font = list(color = TEXT, size = 9), bgcolor = BG,
                  orientation = "v"),
    margin = list(l = 55, r = 10, t = 38, b = 42),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}

# ── show_plots: grid 2+2+1 (filtrado por sc e/ou k) ─────────────────────────
show_plots <- function(d, sc = NULL, k = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(sc)) d <- filter(d, scenario == sc)
  if (!is.null(k))  d <- filter(d, K == k)
  p <- list(
    h1     = make_ply(d, "mean_h1",          "AoI médio h₁ (slots)"),
    risk   = make_ply(d, "mean_risk",         "Risco médio total"),
    frames = make_ply(d, "frames_per_drone",  "Frames entregues / drone"),
    util   = make_ply(d, "channel_util",      "Util. canal vídeo"),
    h2     = make_ply(d, "mean_h2",           "AoI médio h₂ (slots)")
  )
  row <- function(...) div(style = "display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px;", ...)
  col <- function(w)   div(style = paste0("flex:", w, "; min-width:0;"))
  tagList(
    row(tagAppendChildren(col(1), p$h1),     tagAppendChildren(col(1), p$risk)),
    row(tagAppendChildren(col(1), p$frames), tagAppendChildren(col(1), p$util)),
    div(style = "margin-bottom:8px;", p$h2)
  )
}

# ── k_tabs: sub-tabs K para um cenário ───────────────────────────────────────
k_tabs <- function(sc, d, uid) {
  k_vals <- sort(unique(d$K))
  panels <- lapply(k_vals, function(k) {
    nav_panel(paste0("K = ", k), show_plots(d, sc, k))
  })
  do.call(navset_tab, c(panels, list(id = paste0("ktab_", uid, "_", sc))))
}

# ── Mapa de risco + rotas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.HS <- matrix(c(
    28,   24, .10,  90,   56,   28, .10,  90,   76,   46, .10, 130,
   102,   50, .10, 210,  137,   57, .10, 210,  181,   72, .10, 210,
   297,  376, .10, 210,  261,  415, .10, 210,  281,  402, .10, 210,
   186,  455, .10, 210,  107,  488, .10, 210, -128,  -49, .10, 210,
  -233,  -71, .10, 210, -183,  -68, .10, 210, -754,  567, .10, 210,
  -686,  530, .10, 210, -621,  502, .10, 210, -587,  481, .10, 210,
  -658,  499, .10, 210, -695,  518, .10, 210, -720,  524, .10, 210
), ncol = 4, byrow = TRUE)

make_route_map <- function(scenario) {
  cell  <- 33
  n_seq <- seq(-350 + cell/2, 350  - cell/2, by = cell)
  e_seq <- seq(-1300 + cell/2, 1300 - cell/2, by = cell)
  grid  <- expand.grid(N = n_seq, E = e_seq)
  grid$risk <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(.HS))) {
    dN <- grid$N - .HS[i, 1]; dE <- grid$E - .HS[i, 2]
    grid$risk <- grid$risk + .HS[i, 3] * exp(-(dN^2 + dE^2) / (2 * .HS[i, 4]^2))
  }
  grid$risk <- pmin(grid$risk, 1)

  two_routes <- grepl("2r",    scenario)
  is_astar   <- grepl("astar", scenario)
  ltype      <- if (is_astar) "dashed" else "solid"
  title_lbl  <- c(
    `1r_static` = "Static · 1 rota",  `1r_astar`  = "Risk A★ · 1 rota",
    `2r_static` = "Static · 2 rotas", `2r_astar`  = "Risk A★ · 2 rotas"
  )[scenario]

  ROUTE <- "#74c0fc"; BS_COL <- "#ffd700"
  GRID_C <- "#2a2a4a"; TXT <- "#cdd6f4"; BG_C <- "#13131f"

  p <- ggplot(grid, aes(x = N, y = E)) +
    geom_raster(aes(fill = risk), interpolate = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c(BG_C, "#2d1800", "#7a3200", "#bb1800", "#ff4400"),
      limits  = c(0, 1), guide = "none"
    ) +
    annotate("segment", x=50, xend=50, y=-1000, yend=1000,
             colour=ROUTE, linewidth=1.1, linetype=ltype) +
    annotate("segment", x=50, xend=50, y=100, yend=350,
             colour=ROUTE, linewidth=1.6,
             arrow=arrow(length=unit(4,"pt"), type="closed")) +
    annotate("point", x=50, y=c(-1000,1000),
             shape=21, colour=ROUTE, fill=BG_C, size=1.8) +
    {if (two_routes) list(
      annotate("segment", x=-50, xend=-50, y=-1000, yend=1000,
               colour=ROUTE, linewidth=1.1, linetype=ltype),
      annotate("segment", x=-50, xend=-50, y=100, yend=350,
               colour=ROUTE, linewidth=1.6,
               arrow=arrow(length=unit(4,"pt"), type="closed")),
      annotate("point", x=-50, y=c(-1000,1000),
               shape=21, colour=ROUTE, fill=BG_C, size=1.8)
    ) else NULL} +
    annotate("point", x=0, y=0, shape=17, size=3.2, colour=BS_COL) +
    annotate("text",  x=18, y=-90, label="gNB",
             colour=BS_COL, size=2.1, hjust=0) +
    annotate("text", x=50, y=-1055, label="W",
             colour=ROUTE, size=2.0, hjust=0.5, fontface="bold") +
    annotate("text", x=50, y= 1055, label="E",
             colour=ROUTE, size=2.0, hjust=0.5, fontface="bold") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-180,180), ylim=c(-1100,1100)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(-50,0,50), labels=c("−50","0","+50")) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-1000,1000,500),
                       labels=function(y) paste0(y/1000," km")) +
    labs(title=title_lbl, x="Norte (m)", y=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=8) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill=BG_C,   colour=NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill=BG_C,   colour=NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour=GRID_C, linewidth=0.25),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title  = element_text(colour=TXT, size=8.5, face="bold",
                                 hjust=0.5, margin=margin(b=3)),
      axis.text   = element_text(colour="#a6adc8", size=6.5),
      axis.title  = element_text(colour="#a6adc8", size=7),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 2, 4, 2)
    )
  p
}

route_map_tag <- function(scenario, width=180, height=440) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext=".png")
  on.exit(unlink(tmp), add=TRUE)
  ggsave(tmp, make_route_map(scenario),
         width=width/96, height=height/96, dpi=96, bg="#13131f")
  tags$img(src=knitr::image_uri(tmp), width=paste0(width,"px"),
           style="display:block; border-radius:4px; flex-shrink:0;")
}

scene_panel <- function(sc, d, uid) {
  div(style="display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;",
    div(style="flex:0 0 180px; padding-top:2px;", route_map_tag(sc)),
    div(style="flex:1; min-width:0;", k_tabs(sc, d, uid))
  )
}

# ── Risk Gap por experimento ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_risk_gap <- function(d, highlight) {
  pols_all <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(d$policy))

  df_gap <- d |>
    group_by(C, policy) |>
    summarise(risk = mean(mean_risk, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") |>
    group_by(C) |>
    mutate(
      rr   = risk[match("round-robin", policy)],
      norm = risk / rr
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  col_for  <- function(pol) if (pol %in% highlight) POL_COLORS[pol] else "#4a4a6a"
  wid_for  <- function(pol) if (pol %in% highlight) 3    else 1.2
  opa_for  <- function(pol) if (pol %in% highlight) 1.0  else 0.35
  size_for <- function(pol) if (pol %in% highlight) 7    else 0

  pols_ord <- c(highlight,
                setdiff(intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(df_gap$policy)),
                        c(highlight, "round-robin")),
                "round-robin")

  p_gap <- plot_ly()
  for (pol in pols_ord) {
    d2 <- filter(df_gap, policy == pol)
    if (!nrow(d2)) next
    is_hl <- pol %in% highlight
    is_rr <- pol == "round-robin"
    p_gap <- add_trace(p_gap,
      data = d2, x = ~C, y = ~norm,
      type = "scatter", mode = if (is_hl) "lines+markers" else "lines",
      name = pol,
      opacity = if (is_rr) 0.6 else opa_for(pol),
      line = list(
        color = if (is_rr) "#888899" else col_for(pol),
        width = if (is_rr) 1.5       else wid_for(pol),
        dash  = if (is_rr) "dot"     else "solid"
      ),
      marker = list(color=col_for(pol), size=size_for(pol), symbol="circle"),
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        "<b>", pol, "</b><br>C=%{x}<br>Risco/RR=%{y:.3f}<extra></extra>"
      )
    )
  }

  label_annots <- lapply(highlight, function(pol) {
    d2 <- filter(df_gap, policy == pol)
    if (!nrow(d2)) return(NULL)
    xr <- max(d2$C, na.rm=TRUE)
    yr <- d2$norm[which.max(d2$C)]
    list(x=xr+1, y=yr, text=pol, xanchor="left", showarrow=FALSE,
         font=list(color=POL_COLORS[pol], size=10))
  })
  label_annots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), label_annots)

  layout(p_gap,
    title = list(
      text = "Risk Gap vs Carga — normalizado pelo baseline round-robin",
      font = list(color=TEXT, size=13)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title="Capacidade C", color=AXIS, gridcolor=GRID,
                 tickvals=C_TICKS, zeroline=FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title="Risco médio / round-robin  (RR = 1.0)",
                 color=AXIS, gridcolor=GRID, zeroline=FALSE, tickformat=".2f"),
    shapes = list(list(type="line", x0=min(C_TICKS), x1=max(C_TICKS),
                       y0=1, y1=1, line=list(color="#888899", dash="dot", width=1.2))),
    annotations = c(
      list(list(x=min(C_TICKS), y=1.005, text="baseline (round-robin)",
                xanchor="left", showarrow=FALSE,
                font=list(color="#888899", size=9))),
      label_annots
    ),
    plot_bgcolor=PANEL, paper_bgcolor=BG,
    font   = list(color=TEXT, size=10),
    legend = list(font=list(color=TEXT, size=9), bgcolor=BG, tracegroupgap=2),
    margin = list(l=70, r=120, t=55, b=50),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  ) |> config(displayModeBar=FALSE)
}

# ── Supressão + K mínimo + heatmap ──────────────────────────────────────────
make_supr_plots <- function(d) {
  pols_all <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(d$policy))
  k_all    <- sort(unique(d$K))
  dash_seq <- c("solid","dash","dot","dashdot","longdash","longdashdot")
  DASH_K   <- setNames(dash_seq[seq_along(k_all)], as.character(k_all))

  df_s <- d |>
    mutate(supr = 1 - channel_util) |>
    group_by(C, K, policy) |>
    summarise(supr = mean(supr, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  p_supr <- plot_ly()
  for (pol in pols_all) {
    for (k in k_all) {
      d2 <- filter(df_s, policy==pol, K==k)
      if (!nrow(d2)) next
      p_supr <- add_trace(p_supr,
        data=d2, x=~C, y=~supr,
        type="scatter", mode="lines+markers", name=pol,
        legendgroup=pol, showlegend=(k==k_all[1]),
        line=list(color=POL_COLORS[pol], dash=DASH_K[as.character(k)], width=2),
        marker=list(color=POL_COLORS[pol], size=4),
        hovertemplate=paste0("<b>",pol,"</b> K=",k,
          "<br>C=%{x}<br>Supressão=%{y:.1%}<extra></extra>")
      )
    }
  }
  p_supr <- layout(p_supr,
    title=list(text="Taxa de Supressão de Canal (média das 4 rotas)",
               font=list(color=TEXT, size=12)),
    xaxis=list(title="Capacidade C", color=AXIS, gridcolor=GRID,
               tickvals=C_TICKS, zeroline=FALSE),
    yaxis=list(title="Supressão", color=AXIS, gridcolor=GRID,
               tickformat=".0%", zeroline=FALSE),
    shapes=list(
      list(type="line", x0=min(C_TICKS), x1=max(C_TICKS),
           y0=1-QOS_TARGET, y1=1-QOS_TARGET,
           line=list(color="#ff6b6b", dash="dash", width=1.5)),
      list(type="line", x0=min(C_TICKS), x1=max(C_TICKS),
           y0=0.10, y1=0.10,
           line=list(color="#ffa94d", dash="dot", width=1.2))
    ),
    annotations=list(
      list(x=min(C_TICKS), y=1-QOS_TARGET+0.013, showarrow=FALSE,
           text=paste0("QoS target (", round((1-QOS_TARGET)*100), "%)"),
           font=list(color="#ff6b6b", size=9)),
      list(x=min(C_TICKS), y=0.115, showarrow=FALSE,
           text="10% alerta", font=list(color="#ffa94d", size=9))
    ),
    plot_bgcolor=PANEL, paper_bgcolor=BG, font=list(color=TEXT, size=10),
    legend=list(font=list(color=TEXT, size=9), bgcolor=BG),
    margin=list(l=65, r=10, t=45, b=45), hovermode="x unified"
  ) |> config(displayModeBar=FALSE)

  k_needed <- d |>
    group_by(C, policy, scenario) |>
    summarise(
      k_min = { ok <- K[channel_util >= QOS_TARGET]
                if (length(ok) > 0) min(ok) else NA_real_ },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    group_by(C, policy) |>
    summarise(k_min = mean(k_min, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  k_max_avail <- max(d$K)

  p_kmin <- plot_ly()
  for (pol in pols_all) {
    d2 <- filter(k_needed, policy==pol)
    if (!nrow(d2)) next
    p_kmin <- add_trace(p_kmin,
      data=d2, x=~C, y=~k_min, type="scatter", mode="lines+markers", name=pol,
      line=list(color=POL_COLORS[pol], width=2),
      marker=list(color=POL_COLORS[pol], size=5),
      hovertemplate=paste0("<b>",pol,"</b><br>C=%{x}<br>K mín=%{y:.1f}<extra></extra>")
    )
  }
  p_kmin <- layout(p_kmin,
    title=list(text=sprintf("K mínimo para canal ≥ %.0f%% (média 4 rotas)", QOS_TARGET*100),
               font=list(color=TEXT, size=12)),
    xaxis=list(title="Capacidade C", color=AXIS, gridcolor=GRID,
               tickvals=C_TICKS, zeroline=FALSE),
    yaxis=list(title="K necessário", color=AXIS, gridcolor=GRID, zeroline=FALSE,
               tickvals=k_all, ticktext=paste0("K=", k_all)),
    shapes=list(list(type="line", x0=min(C_TICKS), x1=max(C_TICKS),
      y0=k_max_avail, y1=k_max_avail,
      line=list(color="#51cf66", dash="dash", width=1.5))),
    annotations=list(list(x=min(C_TICKS), y=k_max_avail+0.15, showarrow=FALSE,
      text=paste0("K disponível = ", k_max_avail),
      font=list(color="#51cf66", size=9))),
    plot_bgcolor=PANEL, paper_bgcolor=BG, font=list(color=TEXT, size=10),
    legend=list(font=list(color=TEXT, size=9), bgcolor=BG),
    margin=list(l=65, r=10, t=45, b=45)
  ) |> config(displayModeBar=FALSE)

  hm <- d |>
    group_by(K, C) |>
    summarise(util=mean(channel_util, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  p_hmap <- plot_ly(hm,
    x=~C, y=~factor(K, levels=k_all), z=~util,
    type="heatmap",
    colorscale=list(c(0,"#c0392b"), c(QOS_TARGET,"#f39c12"), c(1,"#1D9E75")),
    zmin=0, zmax=1,
    hovertemplate="K=%{y}  C=%{x}<br>Util=%{z:.1%}<extra></extra>",
    colorbar=list(title=list(text="Util.<br>canal", font=list(color=TEXT)),
                  tickformat=".0%", font=list(color=TEXT),
                  bgcolor=BG, bordercolor=GRID)
  ) |>
    layout(
      title=list(text="Mapa K × C: utilização do canal (média políticas e rotas)",
                 font=list(color=TEXT, size=12)),
      xaxis=list(title="Capacidade C", color=AXIS, tickvals=C_TICKS),
      yaxis=list(title="K (slots/época)", color=AXIS),
      plot_bgcolor=PANEL, paper_bgcolor=BG, font=list(color=TEXT, size=10),
      margin=list(l=65, r=10, t=45, b=45)
    ) |> config(displayModeBar=FALSE)

  list(supr=p_supr, kmin=p_kmin, hmap=p_hmap)
}

# ── Build tab completo para um experimento ───────────────────────────────────
build_exp_tab <- function(exp_name, exp_df) {
  uid  <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", exp_name)
  hl   <- get_exp_highlight(exp_name)
  pols <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(exp_df$policy))
  sp   <- make_supr_plots(exp_df)

  nav_panel(
    get_exp_label(exp_name),
    navset_tab(
      nav_panel("Geral",    show_plots(exp_df)),
      nav_panel("Risk Gap",
        p(style="color:#a6adc8; font-size:0.85em; margin:4px 0 8px;",
          HTML(paste0("round-robin = 1.0 (baseline). ",
               "Curvas em destaque: <b>",
               paste(hl, collapse="</b>, <b>"), "</b>."))),
        make_risk_gap(exp_df, hl)
      ),
      nav_panel("Demanda Suprimida",
        p(style="color:#a6adc8; font-size:0.85em; margin:4px 0 8px;",
          HTML(sprintf(paste0("QoS target: util. canal ≥ %.0f%%. ",
               "Traços por K: — sólido · -- dash · ··· dot · -·- dashdot."),
               QOS_TARGET*100))),
        sp$supr,
        div(style="display:flex; gap:12px; margin-top:8px;",
          div(style="flex:1;", sp$kmin),
          div(style="flex:1;", sp$hmap)
        )
      ),
      nav_panel("A★ · 1 rota",     scene_panel("1r_astar",  exp_df, uid)),
      nav_panel("A★ · 2 rotas",    scene_panel("2r_astar",  exp_df, uid)),
      nav_panel("Static · 1 rota", scene_panel("1r_static", exp_df, uid)),
      nav_panel("Static · 2 rotas",scene_panel("2r_static", exp_df, uid)),
      id = paste0("tabs_", uid)
    )
  )
}
```

> **`r nrow(df)` runs** carregados · K ∈ {`r paste(sort(unique(df$K)), collapse=", ")`} · C `r min(df$C)`–`r max(df$C)` · `r length(unique(df$experiment))` experimentos · `r length(unique(df$policy))` políticas distintas · clique na legenda para filtrar.

```{r main-tabs}
experiments <- unique(df$experiment)
top_panels  <- lapply(experiments, function(exp) {
  build_exp_tab(exp, filter(df, experiment == exp))
})
do.call(navset_tab, c(top_panels, list(id = "exp_tabs")))
```
